summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of HookForge V2 restructuring with 4-step workflow (Find Video → Analyze Hook → Face Swap → Generate Video). Tested all backend APIs including new video prompt generation endpoints, and verified frontend UI changes including Stepper component, preserve/custom mode toggle, frame selection (1-3 frames), and video brief generation. All core features working correctly: Stepper visible on all 4 pages, default preserve mode hides customization chips, Customize Scene toggle reveals chips, Generate Video Prompt auto-generates structured prompt via LLM (10-20s), Generate Video saves brief with status 'pending_provider_selection' (NO actual video generation, as intended). History page correctly displays face swap thumbnails and video briefs.

backend_issues.notes: POST /api/videos/{id}/customize rejects solid-color test images (expected validation behavior). All new video generation endpoints working correctly: generate-video-prompt (10-20s), generate-video (saves brief), get-video-job, get-customization-video-jobs.
